label: Map edges examined and rejected in round 2 grounding
summary: Map edges examined and rejected in round 2 grounding. (1) PSR route STMT-FACT-REQUIRES-SUFFICIENT-REASON / STMT-CC100-11-PLURAL-EXISTENCE-EXPLANATION -> STMT-EVERY-CONTINGENT-GROUNDED-AT: the only available bridge (a sufficient reason for an actual concretum's existence is an actual concrete ground of it) would carry the whole conclusion, so the result would be a transcription; it needs typed reason vocabulary (reasons as facts vs. beings) first. (2) STMT-LEIBNIZ-SERIES-SUFFICIENT-REASON -> STMT-EVERY-CONTINGENT-GROUNDED-AT: the series reason is about the totality, not each member. (3) Splitting STMT-ESSE-CAUSE-IS-ACTUAL-CONCRETE-GROUND into 'causes of esse exist', 'are concrete' and 'ground their effects': a decomposition into the target's conjuncts, not a derivation; replaced by the dependence route. (4) STMT-CC100-10-CAUSE-EFFECT-NONOVERLAP -> STMT-ACTUAL-GROUNDING-ASYMMETRIC: nonoverlap excludes self-grounding only under a grounding-as-causation bridge and gives no exclusion of two-cycles. (5) STMT-CC100-10-ACTUAL-CAUSE-EFFECT as support for STMT-SIMPLE-PRIORITY-RELATES-ACTUAL-CONCRETA: priority is not causation (DISAMB-PRIORITY-SIMPLE-OR-IN-TIME); not recorded. Source statements without Lean declarations (q.44 a.1, CC100 #4/#10/#11, Koons 1996) cannot bind a derivation and are recorded as supports relations with gap notes. Rejection records that the leads were examined; it neither refutes nor establishes any target.
